functions.name: Geography.FromWellKnownText
functions.signature: Geography.FromWellKnownText(input as nullable text) as nullable record
functions.summary: Translates text representing a geographic value in Well-Known Text (WKT) format into a structured record.

functions.name: Geography.ToWellKnownText
functions.signature: Geography.ToWellKnownText(input as nullable record, optional omitSRID as nullable logical) as nullable text
functions.summary: Translates a structured geographic point value into its Well-Known Text (WKT) representation.

functions.name: GeographyPoint.From
functions.signature: GeographyPoint.From(longitude as number, latitude as number, optional z as nullable number, optional m as nullable number, optional srid as nullable number) as record
functions.summary: Creates a record representing a geographic point from parts.

functions.name: Geometry.FromWellKnownText
functions.signature: Geometry.FromWellKnownText(input as nullable text) as nullable record
functions.summary: Translates text representing a geometric value in Well-Known Text (WKT) format into a structured record.

functions.name: Geometry.ToWellKnownText
functions.signature: Geometry.ToWellKnownText(input as nullable record, optional omitSRID as nullable logical) as nullable text
functions.summary: Translates a structured geometric point value into its Well-Known Text (WKT) representation.

functions.name: GeometryPoint.From
functions.signature: GeometryPoint.From(x as number, y as number, optional z as nullable number, optional m as nullable number, optional srid as nullable number) as record
functions.summary: Creates a record representing a geometric point from parts.

functions.name: Record.AddField
functions.signature: Record.AddField(record as record, fieldName as text, value as any, optional delayed as nullable logical) as record
functions.summary: Adds a field to a record.

functions.name: Record.Combine
functions.signature: Record.Combine(records as list) as record
functions.summary: Combines the records in the given list.

functions.name: Record.Field
functions.signature: Record.Field(record as record, field as text) as any
functions.summary: Returns the value of the specified field in a record.

functions.name: Record.FieldCount
functions.signature: Record.FieldCount(record as record) as number
functions.summary: Returns the number of fields in the record.

functions.name: Record.FieldNames
functions.signature: Record.FieldNames(record as record) as list
functions.summary: Returns the names of the fields.

functions.name: Record.FieldOrDefault
functions.signature: Record.FieldOrDefault(record as nullable record, field as text, optional defaultValue as any) as any
functions.summary: Returns the value of the specified field in a record or the default value if the field is not found.

functions.name: Record.FieldValues
functions.signature: Record.FieldValues(record as record) as list
functions.summary: Returns a list of the field values.

functions.name: Record.FromList
functions.signature: Record.FromList(list as list, fields as any) as record
functions.summary: Returns a record given a list of field values and a set of fields.

functions.name: Record.FromTable
functions.signature: Record.FromTable(table as table) as record
functions.summary: Creates a record from a table of the form {[Name = name, Value = value]}.

functions.name: Record.HasFields
functions.signature: Record.HasFields(record as record, fields as any) as logical
functions.summary: Indicates whether the record has the specified fields.

functions.name: Record.RemoveFields
functions.signature: Record.RemoveFields(record as record, fields as any, optional missingField as nullable number) as record
functions.summary: Removes the specified field(s) from the input record.

functions.name: Record.RenameFields
functions.signature: Record.RenameFields(record as record, renames as list, optional missingField as nullable number) as record
functions.summary: Applies rename(s) from a list in the form { old, new }.

functions.name: Record.ReorderFields
functions.signature: Record.ReorderFields(record as record, fieldOrder as list, optional missingField as nullable number) as record
functions.summary: Reorders the field(s) specified into the new order.

functions.name: Record.SelectFields
functions.signature: Record.SelectFields(record as record, fields as any, optional missingField as nullable number) as record
functions.summary: Returns a record that contains only the specified fields.

functions.name: Record.ToList
functions.signature: Record.ToList(record as record) as list
functions.summary: Returns a list of values containing the field values of the input record.

functions.name: Record.ToTable
functions.signature: Record.ToTable(record as record) as table
functions.summary: Returns a table with each row being a field name and value of the input record.

functions.name: Record.TransformFields
functions.signature: Record.TransformFields(record as record, transformOperations as list, optional missingField as nullable number) as record
functions.summary: Returns a record after applying specified transformations.
